score_convention: score:conceded is always tested policy:opponent, including blue-side rows

evaluation.note: Two development-style opponents are the mixture experts, not unknown opponents. Six primary baseline records and two supplementary baseline records are audited historical imports. Screens/prefixes are not extra cases.

runtime.scope: single fighter upper observation/inference/decode + frozen lower observation/inference/cache/target; excludes physics and output sanitization

evidence_scope: Local fixed-condition comparison, not independent population trials, official Elo, or victories over original external policies. Raw recordings and training/evaluation workspace are retained locally, not included in this publication.
